name: Clothing / saree store
notes: Purchases are lumpy and occasion-driven. Lead with festivals and new stock, not discounts.

reactivation.note: One-time win-back for imported old customers. The first message also asks for consent; only people who reply Haan get regular messages.
reactivation.template: Namaste {name} ji! {shop} se yaad kar rahe hain. Hamare yahan nayi festival aur shaadi collection aayi hai. Kya hum aapko kabhi-kabhi nayi collection ki khabar WhatsApp par bhej sakte hain? Bas Haan ya Na likh dijiye. 🙏
